category: premium-account and voucher reseller (Indonesian: IDR pricing, local bank transfer)

free_tier.stated: No free tier of its own; it resells the vendor's free slot: 'Free - 150 MB, 1 Active, 1 Mbit/s, Free'. Its paid Indoleech ladder runs Rp 30,000 (10 GB) to Rp 440,000 (1024 GB) per 30 days.
free_tier.notes: Prices are quoted in thousands of rupiah without the 'Rp' prefix in the table ('30.000' = Rp 30,000).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: it sells the vendor's entitlement

egress.terms: Whatever the underlying service grants; ViooMax's own table restates 1 Gbit/s paid and unlimited download.

interface_detail: Web catalogue with an order form; the reseller describes buying by 'transfer rupiah dari bank lokal melalui ATM, Mobile Banking, atau ebanking'.
tooling: None to install; the buyer receives an account or voucher for the underlying service.
chaining: The workaround layer for the Indonesian payment gate: it converts an IDR bank transfer into a foreign service's premium entitlement. It chains with nothing itself and it exists only because the underlying sites cannot be paid for locally.

limits.value: manual order process; prices 'sewaktu-waktu bisa berubah karena perubahan kurs'

limits_note: Ordering is by contact form, not self-service checkout, so delivery depends on an operator.
binding_note: The reseller imposes no technical limit; whatever it resells binds after purchase.

identity_cost.detail: The site's selling point is the absence of international rails: 'pengguna ... Indonesia bisa memiliki account Indoleech Premium tanpa kartu kredit / credit card, tidak perlu akun Paypol, dll. Cukup transfer rupiah dari bank lokal melalui ATM, Mobile Banking, atau ebanking di Indonesia'. In practice that means an Indonesian bank account is required, which is the gate for anyone outside Indonesia.

reliability_note: Exchange-rate repricing is stated openly, delivery is manual, and the site's own copy is written for search engines rather than customers; there is no published refund or replacement policy on the page read.
confidence_note: The reseller page and its price table were read. Whether it accepts a foreign card is not stated anywhere on the page and is treated as unknown, not as accepted.

evidence.proved: 'tanpa kartu kredit / credit card, tidak perlu akun Paypol, dll. Cukup transfer rupiah dari bank lokal melalui ATM, Mobile Banking, atau ebanking di Indonesia'

price ladder: 'Torrent 10G 30.000 / 85.000 / 162.000 / 300.000', 'Torrent 1000G 1024 GB 30 Active 440.000 / 1.250.000 / 2.400.000 / 4.400.000'; 'Harga di atas sewaktu-waktu bisa berubah karena perubahan kurs'

price_per_tb_month: IDR 30,000 per 30 days for a 10 GB Indoleech slot; IDR 440,000 for 1 TB
notes: Cleanest example of a payment gate producing a local middleman: the reseller's entire pitch is 'no credit card, no PayPal'. It also resells Debrid-Link, LinkSnappy and Katfile, so it is the Indonesian on-ramp to the global debrid market.

extras.resells: Indoleech, Debrid-Link, LinkSnappy, Katfile, and others
extras.self_description: 'reseller / agen resmi Account Premium berlisensi di Indonesia'
